LESSON: SELECTED SURAH

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN 1.1 Arabic alphabet By the end of the sub-strand the  Learners read simp
Topic 1.2: Selected Surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Selected Surah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate the boards. significance of Qur’an 
2. Name the foster mother of (AbdulMutwalib and Abu Twali

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Appreciate the boards. significance of Qur’an 
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate the boards. significance of Qur’an . Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Name the foster mother of (AbdulMutwalib and Abu Twali
   In simple words: practise until you can name the foster mother of (AbdulMutwalib and Abu Twali. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Selected Surah using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Selected Surah in the examples.
2. Explain Selected Surah to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected Surah.
4. Show that you can: Appreciate the boards. significance of Qur’an 

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Surah using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Surah important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
